title: The workflow that sent two welcome emails
blurb: Effect replays and unconditional checkpoints caused double effects.
prompt: A customer got two welcome emails and an order never shipped, because the draft retried a timed-out effect without the ledger and overwrote checkpoints unconditionally. The same run floated to a new definition mid-flight. Review it, fix it, and prove effects are exactly-once under replay.
aiNote: The draft retries side effects without consulting the effect ledger, so a timeout that actually sent the email sends it again, and it writes checkpoints unconditionally so a duplicate worker advances a run past a step whose effect never ran.
testIdea: Crash after effect commit but before checkpoint advance and assert replay skips the effect; run two workers over one run and assert one advance; compare step events against the checkpoint trail for a completed run.
followUps: What goes in a checkpoint versus the event log?
How would you version a definition without stranding in-flight runs?
When is a step safe to skip on replay?
